description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:.Provide cross-sectoral, Mission-wide support on strategy, project, and activity-level monitoring, evaluation, and learning; and.Provide third-party, field-based monitoring, and data gathering to augment the Mission's evidence base for accountability and decision making..Due to increasing insecurity across the country, strict Embassy security restrictions for chief of mission staff, and a generalised non-permissive implementation environment traditionally monitoring, evaluation, and learning has become difficult. The goal of the Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Support Activity (MELSA) activity is to provide third party MEL tools to staff and partners and help transform USAID/Nigeria into a premier practitioner of program monitoring and evaluation rooted in organizational learning and adaptation. MELSA will provide continuous, on-the-ground, on-demand and systematic support to all USAID/Nigeria technical teams and implementing partners on performance monitoring, data verification, performance and impact evaluations, project- and activity-level monitoring, evaluation and learning plans, organizational learning, capacity building, short term technical assistance, and knowledge management. This activity cross-cuts the USAID Nigeria CDCS supporting all objectives as well as being closely aligned with Goals 1- 4 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan...
